before_results.readmission: A missed positive matters more because a patient who will be readmitted gets no extra support, like a follow up call, and may return to hospital unprepared. A false alarm on the other hand costs some time and a call to a patient who didn't even need it.
before_results.diabetes: Once again a missed positive matters more. An adult with diabetes who isn't flagged goes untested and untreated. A false alarm only means a test that came back negative which is cheap.
